description: Footnotes runs in tandem with the NTS Book Club, a rolling series of reads chosen by and for our Supporters, with discussion unfolding over on the Discord. Each episode hands the reins to an author, or someone deep in the world of the current book, to share a personal selection of music inspired by the text - with excerpts read straight from the book itself.
